text:
tara: FYI I opened PR #527 with the patchnotes draft for the July micro-release. Focus areas: Ruby + PHP snippet updates, a short migration note for model pinning, and one "Known issues" blurb about embedding stream truncation. Please eyeball for public wording and runnable examples.

ben: Taking a look. Found one Ruby snippet using `Redwood::Client.new` without the required keyword arg `api_key:`. Small fix incoming.

rachel: I will check the PHP example. Also can we add a one-line migration callout: 'Pinned routes that reference exact model commits may fallback to a compatible variant if the commit is pruned'? Keep it non-technical.

tara: Yes keep it short. Use KB-7001 as the migration KB reference (public short-id).

ben: Pushed Ruby fix: `client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV["REDWOOD_API_KEY"])` and tightened example output.

rachel: PHP fix: change `new RedwoodClient()` to `new \Redwood\Client(['api_key' => ...])`. Also removed a stray semicolon in the comment block. Snippet linter happy locally.

docbot: Running snippet-check and linkcheck on branch refs/heads/release/patchnotes-527.
docbot: snippet-check: Ruby OK, PHP OK (warnings: unused import in PHP example - non-blocking). linkcheck: found 1 external 404 (third-party blog).

rachel: Replaced the blog link with the official spec link: spec.redwood.ai/pinning. Pushed.

ci-bot: Re-running checks... docs-lint: flagged phrase "rollback window" as ambiguous for translations. Suggest "rollback plan".

tara: Change accepted. I'll update wording to "planned rollback plan if regressions detected" -> better: "rollback plan" only once.

ben: One more nit: in the changelog bullets we mention "batching improvements". Marketing asked to include the public toggle name. Proposed: "Adaptive batching (available via batching.policy=adaptive)".

tara: Use that exact phrasing. Also add the rollout date: Aug 2 UTC and staged canary at 3%.

rachel: Added a short "How to smoke test" snippet for the CLI: `redwoodctl smoke --scenario=short-chat --timeout=20s` with expected JSON `{"status":"ok"}`. I'll leave it in PR comments.

ben: CI note: docs preflight found a trailing comma in the JSON example; fixed in latest commit.

docbot: Final run: snippet-check: all pass. linkcheck: all links 200. docs-lint: vocabulary fix applied.

ci-bot: All checks green. Ready for editorial pass.

tara: Plan: merge after one quick editorial pass tomorrow morning. If anything pops during canary, we'll follow the rollback plan in the relnotes and notify customers. Thanks! :shipit:
